faq.q: Where is Footscray Dental Studio located?
faq.a: We're located at 289 Barkly St, Footscray VIC 3011, within walking distance of local buses, trams and the train network.

faq.q: What services do you offer?
faq.a: We provide general and preventive dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, restorative dentistry, All-on-X dental implants, and emergency dentistry.

faq.q: Do you accept new patients?
faq.a: Yes, we welcome new patients and offer a New Patient Exam & Clean — see our current offers for details.

faq.q: What health funds do you accept?
faq.a: We accept all major health funds, with on-the-spot claiming available through HICAPS.

faq.q: Is parking available?
faq.a: Yes — convenient 1-hour street parking is available nearby, plus dedicated on-site parking for longer appointments.

faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: You can book online or call us on (03) 9000 0792. Our team is happy to help find a time that suits you.

about.story:
Welcome to Footscray Dental Studio — a fresh, modern chapter for a practice with a strong foundation in the local community. The practice is now under new management, building on the foundations of EZY Dental Group while bringing fresh leadership, experience and a genuine commitment to making every patient's dental experience comfortable, personalised and positive.

Our team has been providing dental services to the local community for many years, with a strong focus on quality care, patient relationships and positive dental experiences. Together, our practitioners bring more than 20 years of combined experience across general and comprehensive dental services.

We believe great dentistry is about more than treating teeth — it's about getting to know our patients, understanding their individual needs, and helping them feel comfortable and confident in their care. As your local dental studio, we're proud to be part of the Footscray community and look forward to caring for generations of patients and families.

Whether you're visiting for a routine check-up, preventive care, or more comprehensive treatment, our team is here to provide professional care with a warm, personalised approach.

**Formerly Ezy Dental Group.** Footscray Dental Studio is the same practice, at the same address on Barkly St, with many of the same familiar faces. The name and leadership have changed; our commitment to the Footscray community has not.
about.philosophy_text:
Our philosophy is simple — we want every patient to feel comfortable, respected and genuinely cared for. We take the time to listen, understand each patient's needs, and provide clear, honest advice so they can make informed decisions about their dental health.

We believe dentistry should be personal, preventive and focused on long-term wellbeing. Our approach combines clinical experience and modern dentistry with a warm, approachable environment where patients feel at ease.

We're committed to building lasting relationships with our patients and families, rather than simply providing treatment. For us, success is seeing our patients leave feeling confident about their oral health, knowing they have a dental team they can trust. As a local practice, we're proud to be part of the Footscray community and look forward to caring for our patients for many years to come.

about.continuity_text:
We highly value the contribution and experience of every member of our existing team. As part of the transition to new leadership, several of our existing practitioners and support staff continue with the practice, providing continuity and familiarity for our patients.

At the same time, we've welcomed additional experienced practitioners to the team, strengthening our clinical capabilities and broadening the range of services available — so we can better support the diverse dental needs of the local community. Our focus is on retaining the strengths and relationships that already exist within the practice, while introducing new expertise, ideas and capabilities under new leadership.

childrens-dentistry.intro: Establishing good dental habits early helps set children up for a lifetime of healthy teeth and gums.

composite-bonding.intro: Composite bonding uses a tooth-coloured resin material, carefully applied and shaped to address minor cosmetic concerns such as small chips, gaps, or irregularly shaped teeth.

cosmetic.intro: Cosmetic dentistry covers a range of treatments designed to improve the appearance of your teeth and smile.

smile-makeovers.intro: For patients considering more than one cosmetic or restorative treatment, a smile makeover approach allows everything to be planned together, rather than addressed one treatment at a time.

teeth-whitening.intro: Over time, teeth can become discoloured due to factors such as food and drink, smoking, ageing, or certain medications.

veneers.intro: Porcelain veneers are thin, custom-made shells designed to be bonded to the front surface of your teeth.

emergency-dentistry.intro: Dental emergencies can happen without warning — a sudden toothache, a knocked-out tooth from a fall, or a broken filling that leaves a tooth exposed and sensitive.

check-ups-cleans.intro: Regular dental check-ups and professional cleans form the foundation of good oral health.

digital-xrays.intro: Accurate diagnosis is one of the most important parts of effective dental care — and much of what affects your oral health isn't visible to the naked eye.

fissure-sealants.intro: The chewing surfaces of your back teeth (molars and premolars) contain natural grooves and pits, known as fissures.

fluoride-treatments.intro: Fluoride is a naturally occurring mineral that helps strengthen tooth enamel and supports resistance to acid attacks from plaque bacteria and sugars — one of the main contributors to tooth decay.

gum-disease-care.intro: Healthy gums are just as important as healthy teeth, providing the foundation that supports your teeth in place.

general-preventive.intro: Good oral health starts with prevention. Our general dentistry services are focused on maintaining healthy teeth and gums, identifying potential issues early, and helping you avoid more complex — and often more costly — treatment down the track.

mouthguards.intro: Off-the-shelf mouthguards can feel bulky, ill-fitting, and are often left in a sports bag rather than worn when they're needed most.

services.intro: Footscray Dental Studio provides comprehensive dental care for you and your family, combining modern technology with a warm, personalised approach.

all-on-x-implants.intro: For patients missing most or all of their teeth in an upper or lower jaw, All-on-X is a full-arch implant solution that uses a small number of strategically placed implants — typically four or more, hence "All-on-X" — to support a complete arch of replacement teeth.

crowns-bridges.intro: Crowns and bridges are custom-made restorations used to protect, strengthen or replace teeth. A crown covers and protects a damaged or weakened tooth, while a bridge replaces one or more missing teeth by anchoring to the surrounding teeth.

dental-implants.intro: Dental implants are a long-term option for replacing missing teeth, consisting of a titanium post surgically placed into the jawbone, which acts as an artificial tooth root.

dentures.intro: Dentures are removable appliances used to replace missing teeth, restoring function for eating and speaking, as well as supporting facial structure and appearance.

fillings.intro: When a tooth is affected by decay, a filling is one of the most common ways to restore it — removing the decayed portion of the tooth and replacing it with a durable material to restore shape, function and appearance.

restorative.intro: Restorative dentistry focuses on repairing damaged, decayed or missing teeth to restore comfort, function and confidence.

root-canal.intro: Root canal therapy is a treatment used to address infection or damage to the pulp — the soft tissue inside a tooth containing nerves and blood vessels.

team.name: Dr Adeela Younis
team.bio:
With more than 16 years in general dentistry, Dr. Adeela has built her career around a simple idea: every patient deserves to feel comfortable, understood, and genuinely cared for. Patients quickly notice her warm, welcoming manner and the relaxed atmosphere she creates for people of all ages. Whether she’s handling a routine check-up or a more involved procedure, she stays present throughout, focused on keeping the experience as pain-free and stress-free as possible.

Dr. Adeela earned her Bachelor of Dental Surgery from Baqai Medical University, where alongside her academic achievements, she took on mentoring roles with senior dental students — an early sign of the passion for teaching and knowledge-sharing that’s stayed with her ever since. She has gone on to work alongside respected dental surgeons in Australia and abroad, building particular expertise in root canal therapy, wisdom teeth removal, orthodontics, dental implants, veneers, crowns and bridges, and full smile makeovers.

Her pursuit of the latest training and certifications isn’t just professional — it’s personal. Dr. Adeela is recognised by three global regulatory authorities, though what patients tend to remember most is her kindness and how closely she listens.

As a mother herself, she brings a natural, nurturing touch to treating children, understanding the anxieties young patients can have and working to turn each visit into a positive — even enjoyable — experience. That same warmth extends to how she connects with parents, reflecting her belief that every patient should be treated like family.

Speaking English, Urdu, Hindi, and Punjabi fluently, with working proficiency in Arabic, Dr. Adeela is able to make a wide range of patients feel seen, heard, and at ease.

For her patients, Dr. Adeela Younis is more than a dentist — she’s a trusted partner in their family’s dental health, guided by a gentle hand and a caring heart.

team.name: Dr. Zainab Zahid
team.bio:
With clinical experience spanning both Australia and overseas, Dr. Zahid is a general dentist known for her caring, gentle touch. She works to make every appointment — for patients of any age — as relaxed and stress-free as possible. Her approach centres on high-quality, patient-first care, balancing preventive dentistry with more advanced restorative techniques when needed.

Patient education is a core part of how Dr. Zahid practises; she believes informed patients are better equipped to keep their smiles healthy for life. Building genuine, long-term relationships matters to her too — she’s found that patients who feel truly known tend to see better outcomes and greater overall wellbeing.

Dr. Zahid keeps her skills sharp through regular professional development, making sure she’s up to date with the latest techniques and technology in modern dentistry.

Outside the clinic, she loves to travel, explore new cultures, and try local cuisines wherever she goes. That curiosity and openness carry over into her work, adding warmth to how she connects with her patients.

team.name: Dr. Nikhat H. Syeda
team.bio:
Dr. Nikhat trained as a dentist in India before relocating to Australia to build her career, where she now focuses on delivering dental care centred around each patient’s individual needs.

Her clinical interests lie in preventive, restorative, and general dentistry, with particular emphasis on supporting patients toward lasting oral health. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach, she customises treatment plans to suit each patient, and stays current with evidence-based techniques through continual learning in her field.

Patients often describe Dr. Nikhat’s manner as gentle and caring. She puts thought into making her practice feel warm and unintimidating, and places real value on the relationships she builds with the people she treats — aiming for every visit to be a comfortable, positive one.

Dr. Nikhat speaks English, Hindi, Urdu, Arabic, and Telugu, which allows her to connect with patients from a wide range of cultural backgrounds. She’s particularly focused on making dental care easy to understand and accessible to everyone who walks through the door.

When she’s not at the practice, Dr. Nikhat enjoys interior design, travel, and hosting gatherings with family and friends — she loves turning spaces into welcoming environments and bringing people together for memorable occasions.

faq.q: Are these offers available to all patients?
faq.a: Most offers are available to new and existing patients; suitability for any treatment is confirmed at consultation with your dentist.

faq.q: Can I combine multiple offers?
faq.a: Please contact our team to confirm which offers can be used together, as this may vary depending on your treatment needs.

faq.q: Do offers expire?
faq.a: Offers are subject to change — please check with our team or this page for current availability before booking your appointment.

faq.q: Is the Child Dental Benefits Schedule the same as a free offer?
faq.a: No — CDBS is a government scheme, not a practice promotion. Eligible children can access bulk-billed services; contact us to check eligibility for your child.

faq.q: Is teeth whitening suitable for everyone?
faq.a: Suitability is assessed individually at consultation, as whitening isn't appropriate for every patient or every tooth condition.

faq.q: How do I redeem an offer?
faq.a: Simply mention the offer when booking online or by phone, and our team will confirm the details with you ahead of your appointment.
